x: Tommy Rowe of Herne Hill was the individual winner, with Bill Lucas in second place, and Herne Hill also beat us in the Team Race. The 4 x 220 yards saw a similar result, although Jack Frost had a slight lead at the last take-over, but could not hold T.
There being no Mile race, Len Herbert ran in the 2 Miles event, and after a fine tussle with Tommy Rowe of Herne Hill, Len ran home a good winner in 9 mins. 33.6 secs.

The 3 miles saw Len Herbert and Tommy Rowe out in front and after a good race Len triumphed in the good time of 14 min 39.8 secs. Vic Blowfield won the 1 mile and so far Wandsworth had had the first two home in every running event.

Eric Bishop kept this position on the next stage and then Eddie Short lost one more place to Jim Peters of Essex Beagles and although Bill Lucas took us back into 3rd position our final runner Vern Blowfield found he could not make any impression on Jimmy Wood and Tommy Rowe who were in front of him.
